# Louis C Deng's Blog

> A bilingual personal blog by Louis C Deng: software, computer science, machine learning, literature, art, and life.

Articles are published in English or Traditional Chinese. Follow each page’s HTML language and canonical URL. The HTML pages contain the full content.
